title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: voice recognition set in device settings instead of PowerShell
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documentation supports the configuration routes, Teams Rooms Pro requirement, defaults and transcription prerequisites, and the rollout facts match the roadmap. One minor clarification should distinguish the enrollment overview's general default from the PowerShell reference's exception for express enrollment in previously restricted organizations.

claims.claim: New Android Teams Rooms device settings replace the requirement to configure voice recognition through PowerShell.

claims.quote: Select Rooms. Select Settings followed by the Recognition tab. Enable Configure with device settings. Modify to the desired configuration. | Voice Recognition | Off |
